subject.title: fix(tasks): age out stale cron task history

question: Should OpenClaw automatically delete non-lost terminal cron task history after 30 days for every existing installation, even when that history is below the current per-job row cap?
rationale: This is a new destructive retention default, not a mechanically compelled repair: it changes the amount of operational history preserved for existing users and needs an owner decision on the product contract.

options.title: Adopt the 30-day policy with upgrade proof
options.body: Approve fixed retention as the supported contract, then require evidence that real maintenance prunes only eligible old cron rows and preserves fresh and lost rows.

options.title: Keep the existing cap-only policy
options.body: Reject automatic age-based deletion and leave history governed by the current per-job cap and lost-task cleanup behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-day policy with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Approve fixed retention as the supported contract, then require evidence that real maintenance prunes only eligible old cron rows and preserves fresh and lost rows.
